description.narrative: The proposed project in aligned with the ADB's Strategy 2030, which provides a special attention for the needs of landlocked economies and supports improving regional connectivity and competitiveness by addressing cross-border infrastructure needs. It is also in consistent with ADB's CPS, 2019-2023, for Uzbekistan. The CPS supports Uzbekistan's pursuit for improved quality of peoples' lives and creation of jobs through prioritizing regional cooperation and integration along with private sector development, and reduction of economic and social disparities. It advocates (i) accelerating economic growth through continuing interventions in the transport sector focusing on cross border roads that facilitate development of CAREC transport corridors; (ii) improvement of the growth inclusiveness and sustainability by enhancing employability of the population through skills development and strengthening climate change resilience; and (iii) leveraging regional cooperation by developing regional transportation links and accompanying logistics.

DMF target to replace the procurement of a minibus agreed during MTR mission: One room in makhalla center renovated for conducting trainings and creating handicrafts corner to serve at least 50 women from the local community.
Identify a DMF target to replace the procurement of a minibus by Q2 2024: PMU will get approval from the ADB Gender Division (before or at MTR) to change the minibus purchase. This goal is unlikely to be met because there is no budget set out for the CR, the RRF's successor entity that had previously promised to buy the minibus. Instead, it was decided that the socioeconomically disadvantaged regions of Peshku and Jondor/Zhandor may get equipment to support women's livelihood activities. The PMU for subprojects 1 and 2 will locate current mahalla centers with rooms and facilities that can accommodate the equipment for those projects with little to no upgrades or improvements.
During Loan Review Mission 11-15 Sep 2023, included in the discussion is the identification and implementation of an alternative DMF target that replaces the current procurement of a minibus with, for example, CDC facilities in Bukhara. This is in light of the government budget constraints and institutional complexities as to the maintenance of the purchased bus.
Procurement is ongoing. Data Source: Committee for Roads reports Baseline year: 2021 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2021 Baseline value: N Target year: 2025 Target value: Y Actual value: N
